data.one_liner: Unofficial Dart client for Google AI Gemini, Vertex AI Gemini, and Live API WebSockets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart, type-safe API client for Google AI Gemini and Vertex AI Gemini REST APIs, supporting text generation, image generation, audio, tool calling, embeddings, and Live API WebSocket sessions.
use_when: You need a pure Dart Gemini client for backend services, CLIs, or cross-platform Flutter apps.
You want to connect to both Google AI and Vertex AI using a single unified API client.
You require advanced Gemini features like streaming, tool calling, grounding tools, and WebSocket Live API sessions.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase AI and prefer the official Firebase package ecosystem.
You only need on-device machine learning models rather than cloud-hosted LLM APIs.
strengths: Pure Dart with no Flutter dependency, working across mobile, web, desktop, and server.
Comprehensive coverage of Gemini features including Live API WebSockets, tool calling, and structured outputs.
Unified interface for both Google AI API keys and Vertex AI project routing.
weaknesses: It is an unofficial client, meaning it is not directly maintained or supported by Google.
Requires managing API keys or GCP OAuth credentials manually.
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.12 or later and a valid Google AI API key or Vertex AI project configuration.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Firebase SDK for generative AI integration in Flutter applications.
